machine_facts.signalpulse_validation_scope: Per-instance validation checks finite/non-negative time, non-empty channel, non-negative magnitude, polarity, location and metadata. No collection-level uniqueness key exists.
machine_facts.exact_key_tie_order_behavior: Python stable sorting therefore retains input iterable order for equal (time_ms, channel) keys; this is implementation behavior, not treated here as a documented semantic contract.
machine_facts.receptor_update_detail: _observe_one mutates fast/medium/slow/mean_abs and computes gain after incorporating each individual pulse before the next pulse is observed.

SignalPulse_constructor_search.finding: No stable-main supported example/test located that constructs two pulses with both identical time_ms and identical channel for receptor processing.

v05_process_episode_callers.finding: Observed supported/canonical callers feed episode.pulses produced by v0.5 worlds; no exact-key multiplicity contract is asserted at these callsites.

v05_worlds.finding: Motif offsets are distinct and canonical motif channels are distinct. Noise times are drawn independently from a continuous RNG and noise channels may repeat, so exact-key duplicates are neither intentionally generated nor structurally rejected. Generated episodes are sorted only by (time_ms, channel).

v04_simultaneous_world.finding: The named simultaneous case creates A, B and C at one timestamp, demonstrating same-time multi-channel input but not same-time/same-channel multiplicity.

v05_protocol.finding: The retained protocol discusses temporal order and an order_shuffle condition as the same event multiset with a different canonical temporal order. It does not define ordering semantics for exact same-time/same-channel ties.

multiset_term_inventory.finding: Stable-main receptor-adjacent use of 'multiset' is the v0.5 order_shuffle protocol; it does not specify exact-key simultaneity or permutation invariance inside one (time_ms, channel) key.

simultaneous_term_inventory.finding: Relevant v0.4 theory/world material preserves event time and includes same-time events across distinct channels, but no exact same-channel tie contract was found for the v0.5 receptor public boundary.

duplicate_term_inventory.finding: Repository 'duplicate' occurrences are dominated by other evidence/validation domains; no supported receptor contract forbidding or defining duplicate exact (time_ms, channel) SignalPulse keys was found.
